messages:
sara.b: Draft: boundary curation KPIs & paydown plan for service-surface refactor. Posting checklist — feedback pls.
leo.k: can you drop the checklist here?
sara.b: ```Checklist:
- Ownership clarity per public endpoint (owner, fallback)
- Contract churn < 3% per sprint (measured by public API diffs)
- PR size guidance: prefer < 400 LOC for extraction PRs
- Migration adapter parity tests >= 95%
- Observability: span coverage >= 90% and token-level latency histograms
- Rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with error delta < 0.5%
- Debt paydown target: reduce synchronous cross-service calls by 30% in Q2
- Backlog: close blocked refactor tickets by 40% in first 6 weeks
```
ajay.eng: small callouts — data migrations will need twilight reads and dual-writes for a bit. prefer feature-flagged adapters rather than big cutovers.
maria.pm: timeline? what are we expecting from product and infra?
sara.b: current target: planning + design spikes = 2w; extraction sprints = 6w (3x2w); cutover window = 1w. KPIs measured weekly and attached to the rollout board.
leo.k: how do we actually measure "contract churn" across teams?
sara.b: plan is a lightweight tool that diffs published protobuf/openapi artifacts + a prometheus metric emitted by the contract-proxy when schemas change.
ajay.eng: agree on runbooks. also propose automatic fallback routes to legacy service if latency or error budget breaches during canary.
maria.pm: I'll own the product acceptance tests and dashboard for KPIs (canary metrics, contract churn, PR throughput).
infra-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/refactors/boundary-curation-kpis (doc-id: RFC-4321)
leo.k: :thumbsup: looks reasonable. add a KPI for PR throughput so refactors don't gate other teams (avg days to merge).
sara.b: good call — adding: "avg days to merge < 3" and "blocked PRs < 5 per week" to the checklist.
maria.pm: I'll add the dashboard tiles and schedule a sync with eng leads tomorrow. agenda item for Tue arch sync.
ajay.eng: i'll draft the twilight-read runbook + adapter toggle matrix by EOD.
sara.b: thanks all — will update the doc and ping for review.
